name: retrieval_coverage
description: passage 하나를 보여주고 그 passage가 답하는 subquery를 모두 선택 (사수 Task 3, retriever 평가)

questions.none_option: None of the sub-questions is answered

instructions.title: Does the passage answer the question?
instructions.summary: Read a retrieved passage and mark which sub-questions it answers.
instructions.background: A question was split into sub-questions and a search system retrieved passages for it. We want to know, for each passage, which sub-questions it actually answers.
definitions: One part of the original question.
The passage contains the information needed to answer the sub-question. Mentioning the topic without giving the answer does not count.
howto: Read the sub-question(s), then the passage.
Tick every sub-question this passage answers, or None.
instructions.tip: A passage about the right entity that never states the asked fact does not answer the question.
